queries_run: Visa distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026
Visa business model transition platform value-added services agentic commerce 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 說明 Visa Acceptance Platform（Cybersource、Authorize.net）為雲端架構，提供與電商平台的全通路整合；並列出封閉商務生態、BNPL、加密貨幣（含穩定幣）等另類支付業者，可能同時是夥伴與競爭者。
findings.excerpt: Alternative Payments Providers: These providers, such as closed commerce ecosystems, BNPL solutions and cryptocurrency platforms (including stablecoins), often have a primary focus of enabling payments through ecommerce and mobile channels; however, they are expanding or may expand their offerings to the physical point of sale.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋摘要為二手轉述，無可逐字複製原文，相關線索列於 clues。

clues.claim: Hospitality Net 專家評論：Visa Destinations 被視為探索而非分銷，尚未構成飯店分銷結構轉變，是訊號而非轉移。
Visa FY26 Q2 增值服務約占淨營收 30%、年增 27%；Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect 為 agentic commerce 入口。
clues.source: TIKR: Visa Just Told the Market Where It Thinks Payments Are Headed Next
